manifest.name: Lead Generation
manifest.summary: Generate Leads/Opportunities based on country, industries, size, etc.

behavioral_notes.observation: action_submit stamps an ir.sequence request number, then _perform_request builds an IAP payload (_prepare_iap_payload: lead_number, search_type, country/state codes, optional company size, industry reveal_ids, contact role/seniority) and calls the EXTERNAL IAP 'reveal' service via _iap_contact_mining -> iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc against reveal.endpoint (default https://iap-services.odoo.com) path /api/dnb/1/search_by_criteria (Dun & Bradstreet data). On success _create_leads_from_response bulk-creates crm.lead records (type lead or opportunity) from the returned company data and sets state='done'; there is no local catalog of prospects — the leads are materialized purely from the external provider's response. Metadata cannot show this: the whole acquisition pipeline is an outbound HTTP round-trip, not an internal document flow.

The request is metered: CREDIT_PER_COMPANY=1 and CREDIT_PER_CONTACT=1 credits are billed on the iap.account 'reveal' wallet (account_token + database.uuid sent with every call). _compute_tooltip pre-estimates cost (lead_number companies + contact_number*lead_number contacts). If the IAP response carries credit_error the request sets state='error', error_type='credits' and creates no leads; action_buy_credits opens the IAP top-up URL and crm.iap.lead.helpers._notify_no_more_credit emails record creators (rate-limited via an ir.config_parameter flag). Pay-per-result economics live entirely in code/external service, not in the schema.

lead_vals_from_response maps the provider payload (duns/clearbit_id, name, domain->website, email, phone_numbers, street/city/zip, state_code via _find_state_id) into crm.lead values, stamping reveal_id (inherited from iap_crm) for dedup and lead_mining_request_id for traceability; when search_type='people' the first contact's full_name/email/title enrich contact_name/email_from/function. After creation each lead gets a message_post_with_source('iap_mail.enrich_company') note rendering the full company profile. reveal_ids of leads already in the DB are sent with the request so the provider avoids returning duplicates.

The module only extends crm.lead with a Many2one back-link to the originating mining request, adds that field to _merge_get_fields so it survives lead/opportunity merge, and exposes action_generate_leads which opens the mining-request wizard as a modal from the CRM pipeline. No new state machine on the lead itself — acquired leads enter the standard crm pipeline and are scored/converted by base crm.

behavioral_notes.element: external integration (gap #7) — IAP Reveal / D&B lead data provider
behavioral_notes.observation: Single outbound integration: iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc POST to the Odoo IAP gateway (reveal.endpoint, default https://iap-services.odoo.com) endpoint /api/dnb/1/search_by_criteria. Auth is the iap.account 'reveal' account_token plus database.uuid; payload also carries db_version, db_lang, country_code and existing reveal_ids. No third-party SDK is imported and no raw api-key is stored in the module — credentials are brokered by the iap framework. This is the SOLE source of the leads the module produces; without IAP credits/connectivity the feature yields nothing.

it_architecture.application: crm_iap_mine (Lead Generation — IAP lead-acquisition add-on to CRM)
information_flows: depends: iap_crm (reveal_id, IAP-CRM glue), iap_mail (enrich_company template + no-credit mail)
outbound: crm.iap.lead.mining.request._iap_contact_mining -> IAP reveal service (https://iap-services.odoo.com /api/dnb/1/search_by_criteria) authenticated by iap.account token + db_uuid
side-effect: action_submit -> external request -> crm.lead.create (lead/opportunity) + iap_mail.enrich_company log + credit debit
side-effect: credit_error from IAP -> state='error' + _notify_no_more_credit email to record creators
downstream: created crm.lead enters standard crm pipeline (scoring, stage progression, convert, won/lost)

capabilities: Mine / Acquire External Leads (by country, industry, company size)
IAP Credit Metering & Top-up for Lead Generation
Feed Acquired Leads into the CRM Pipeline
value_streams: Define-criteria -> request -> external mine -> create leads/opportunities -> enrich -> hand to CRM pipeline
Credit lifecycle: estimate -> debit on result -> notify/buy on exhaustion
policies: 5 access rules: all mining config models restricted to group_sale_manager (helpers model is no-access)
credit policy: pay-per-company / pay-per-contact (CREDIT_PER_COMPANY, CREDIT_PER_CONTACT) on iap.account 'reveal'; credit_error halts and notifies
guardrails: MAX_LEAD=200, MAX_CONTACT=5, company-size and state-whitelist (_STATES_FILTER_COUNTRIES_WHITELIST) bounding requests
dedup policy: existing reveal_ids sent to provider to avoid duplicate leads

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services (3.1 / 3.5.1 Generate / manage leads)
classification.rationale: crm_iap_mine is the lead-acquisition front of the CRM value-shop. A value shop solves a customer-finding problem cyclically (Stabell & Fjeldstad: problem-finding/acquisition -> solving -> choice -> execution), and this module performs exactly the problem-finding/acquisition step: the salesperson frames an acquisition problem (criteria: country, industry, size, contact roles), the system mobilizes an external knowledge resource (IAP Reveal / D&B), and materializes prospects as crm.lead records that re-enter the shop's diagnose/qualify/convert loop owned by parent crm. It is not a chain: there is no sequential transform of an inbound order into an outbound product, no inventory or BOM — output is information (leads), value rests on the quality/reputation of the data source, and the activity is iterative (re-run with refined criteria, dedup against prior results). It is a primary activity because it directly creates the pipeline input that downstream sale (chain) monetizes, mapping to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell (3.1/3.5 lead generation). Support was considered (it is a bolt-on, auto_install add-on with no routes) but rejected: its function is value-creating customer acquisition, not internal enablement like IT/HR/finance — the 'support' flavor here is purely architectural (it augments crm), whereas the business activity is squarely primary market-and-sell.

standard_capabilities: lead/opportunity generation from an external data provider by country, state, industry and company size
people/contact discovery filtered by role or seniority
credit-metered requests with pre-estimate tooltip and in-app top-up (action_buy_credits)
automatic company enrichment note on each acquired lead (iap_mail.enrich_company)
deduplication against existing leads via reveal_id
back-link from lead to its mining request, preserved across merges
no-credit email notification to request creators
typical_fits: outbound prospecting teams buying targeted B2B leads on demand
seeding a new territory/segment pipeline with company + contact data
leads flowing straight into standard crm scoring/conversion without extra config
common_gaps: dependence on Odoo IAP credits and connectivity — unusable air-gapped or without a funded reveal account
data provider coverage/quality varies by country (state filtering whitelisted for a few countries only)
no built-in scheduling/automation of recurring mining (manual action_submit per request)
alternative / 3rd-party enrichment providers require custom development
MAX_LEAD=200 / MAX_CONTACT=5 caps may need batching for large campaigns
drive_hints: odoo shell: r = env['crm.iap.lead.mining.request'].create({'name':'Demo','lead_number':3,'search_type':'companies'}); r._prepare_iap_payload()  # inspect outbound payload without spending credits
odoo shell: env['iap.account'].get('reveal').account_token  # confirm reveal wallet is configured

UI: from a CRM pipeline use 'Generate Leads' (crm.lead.action_generate_leads) to open the mining wizard

open_questions: Exact remote semantics of /api/dnb/1/search_by_criteria (result schema, partial-result and pagination behavior) — only the client side is in-repo.
Real per-request credit cost vs. the local CREDIT_PER_COMPANY/CREDIT_PER_CONTACT estimate (authoritative debit happens server-side on IAP).
Whether contact (people) data is ever attached beyond the first contact, and how multi-contact enrichment is surfaced on the lead.
